plan: A priestess who summons tentacles from walls and becomes terrifying when you fight in her zone.
aSurveiller: Her E (Test of Spirit). She rips out your spirit: if you stay near it, her tentacles hit you. Dodge it behind your minions.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: her E stops on the first one hit.
If your spirit is ripped out, move away from it: otherwise you get tethered to her.
Don't fight near walls during her R: her tentacles spawn everywhere.
forces: Very strong when fighting several enemies.
faiblesses: Relies on her E to win a trade.

sorts.Q: Tentacle that slams in a line.
sorts.W: Leaps and makes nearby tentacles strike.
sorts.E: Rips out an enemy's spirit; hitting it hurts the real body.
sorts.R: Slams the ground and spawns a tentacle for each enemy.

momentFort: Strong from the start, very dangerous from level 6.
